title: polydata item draw hints
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkPolyDataItem with draw hints (line width, stipple patterns).

**dataset → input → plot → item → context_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkAxis](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAxis.html) — axis.
- [vtkContextActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContextActor.html) — context actor.
- [vtkFloatArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFloatArray.html) — stores an array of floating-point values.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) — int array.
- [vtkInteractiveArea](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractiveArea.html) — interactive area.
- [vtkPen](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPen.html) — pen.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyData.html) — represents polygonal geometry.
- [vtkPolyDataItem](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataItem.html) — poly data item.
- [vtkRectd](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRectd.html) — rectd.
- [vtkRecti](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRecti.html) — recti.
- [vtkUnsignedCharArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnsignedCharArray.html) — unsigned char array.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
